title: @intentsolutions/core authoring schema index v1
description: Catalog of authoring-contract schemas for the Spec Authority Kernel (SAK). Source of truth: ISEDC Session 8 charter DR-044 (intent-eval-lab/000-docs/044-AT-DECR-isedc-council-session-8-sak-charter-2026-06-09.md) + plan 033 § 14.10 / § 14.A. The marketplace-tier foundation exposes the THREE universal folds (deprecationRegistry, securityChecks, disclosureMarkers) + the universalFolds composition that every per-contract schema inherits by reference (D7). Each per-contract contract is three artifacts — an upstream-base (authored by the open standard), an is-overlay (authored by IS), and the published allOf composition. skill-frontmatter is contract #1 (the walking skeleton). The remaining five (plugin-manifest, agent-definition, mcp-config, hook-config, marketplace-catalog) land on-demand behind a CFO bandwidth sign-off, codegen-generated (D8 — codegen is a hard precondition of contract #2).
